canary.reason: A canary that cannot run proves nothing, so this mode is enabled. It is safe by construction rather than by permission: every canary destination is confined to a subdirectory of the served root, nothing above that subdirectory is addressable through it, and the publisher refuses a canary whose destination resolves to any live one. Live destinations are now fully addressed, which changes none of that: reaching one needs modes.live.state ENABLED here plus both approval variables in the environment, and this mode's enablement grants no part of that.

live.reason: The decision this field was waiting for has been taken. The repository owner has asked, explicitly and repeatedly, for the early capture windows to publish live on the reviewed progression T-180 establishes, T-90 replaces, T-45 replaces, T-20 replaces as the final pregame version, with each refresh publishing the same already-validated release that passed canary and the prior valid release retained when a later refresh fails. That is the authorisation, and this commit is where it is recorded; ops/run_progressive_live_refresh.py is the behaviour it authorises and nothing else may use it. What this grants is narrow. It is the first of the three conditions in what_enabling_live_requires and it is deliberately the only one this repository can hold: the other two are variables in the wizardofodds-production GitHub environment, they are not settable from a commit, and until the owner sets both of them every live publication still refuses by name. So the state here is ENABLED and the gate is not open. Flipping it does not publish anything, does not weaken any other refusal, and does not change a single number: the live release is the canary's own bytes, matched on three independent statements of one rows digest, and the model surface behind it is untouched.

note: A missing switch file reads as DISABLED for every mode. The absence of a prohibition is not an approval.
what_enabling_live_requires: this file's modes.live.state set to ENABLED in a reviewed commit
the NBA_PROP_WOO_PUBLISH environment variable set to that same state
the NBA_PROP_WOO_PUBLISH_APPROVAL environment variable set to modes.live.approval_token
